data.title: Vacancy rate in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Indicator name
metadata.value: Vacancy rate in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually

metadata.label: Indicator description
metadata.value: This indicator measures the vacancy rate in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi  Vacancy rate: It represents the percentage of unfilled job positions out of the total number of job positions (filled and unfilled) available in establishments within the Emirate of Abu Dhabi

metadata.label: Keywords
metadata.value: Vacancy rate, job vacancies, unfilled positions, labour demand

metadata.label: Statistical population
metadata.value: The statistical population includes all establishments operating within the Emirate of Abu Dhabi that employ one or more persons. The following are excluded: households employing domestic workers, diplomatic missions, and international organizations.

metadata.label: Geographic coverage
metadata.value: Geographical coverage includes the three regions in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi: Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra.

metadata.label: Statistical calculation method
metadata.value: [Number of vacant job positions in establishments in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually / (Number of filled positions + Number of vacant positions) in the Emirate of Abu Dhabi - annually]  x 100

aiRecommendation.title: Address Skills Gaps to Reduce Persistent Vacancies
aiRecommendation.title_ar: معالجة فجوات المهارات للحد من الشواغر المستمرة
aiRecommendation.text: Declining vacancy rates indicate improved labour market efficiency, but targeted skills programs are needed to address persistent mismatches between job seekers and available positions.
aiRecommendation.text_ar: تشير معدلات الشواغر المتراجعة إلى تحسن كفاءة سوق العمل، غير أن برامج المهارات المستهدفة ضرورية لمعالجة الفجوات القائمة بين الباحثين عن عمل والمناصب المتاحة.
aiRecommendation.reason: Vacancy rates have decreased from 4.2% in 2021 to 3.2% in 2024, reflecting better alignment between labour supply and demand. Continued workforce development efforts will help close remaining gaps and improve overall market efficiency.
aiRecommendation.reason_ar: انخفضت معدلات الشواغر من 4.2% في عام 2021 إلى 3.2% في عام 2024، مما يعكس تحسناً في التوافق بين العرض والطلب في سوق العمل. وستساعد جهود تطوير القوى العاملة المستمرة في تضييق الفجوات المتبقية وتحسين كفاءة السوق.
